doc.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Opening of the filming session
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Bauer on a snowy morning and asks about his guitar school.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in New York City. And I am really pleased to have Billy Bauer as my guest, who has been playing guitar for many years, and braved some inclement weather to be with us this morning. So I really appreciate it.
A cool guy and a cool day. I would like to ask you first about your guitar institute that you’re working on, your guitar business, your school.
